description: The ultraproduct structure interprets function symbols coordinatewise modulo \(\mathcal U\), and relation symbols by membership of their coordinate truth sets in \(\mathcal U\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Ultraproduct.structure.{u, v, u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {M : α → Type u_2} {u : Ultrafilter α}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} [(a : α) → L.Structure (M a)] : L.Structure ((↑u).Product M)
